title: ColorfulCraft
description: The world cannot be too colorful.
body:
# 幻彩工艺 | ColorfulCraft
## Mod by [幻彩白霜@bilibili](https://space.bilibili.com/3493139849414753)
Welcome to the Minecraft mod what named ColorfulCraft's page! The mod is a vanilla survival expansion that includes:
- Blocks:Add blocks like Calcite Slab,Smooth Basalt Stairs,Stone Wall,etc.
- Foods:Try the Diamond Apple! It makes you invincible.
- Recipes:Add crafting recipes for Tall Grass,Large Fern and Enchanted Golden Apple.
## 🐛 How to Report Issues
Please use the [issue traker](https://github.com/colorful-hoarfrost/ColorfulCraft/issues) linked at the top of the page to report bugs, crashes, and other issues.
